8:27 PM

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
8:27 PM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi: open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM; closed Mondays and national holidays. Entry: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 students up to class 12 free with ID card. Note: the site's last gallery notice (29 May 2023) says Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries were closed for renovation until further notice.

8:28 PM

Open the Indian Railways IRCTC website and check the train timings from New Delhi to Agra tomorrow morning
8:31 PM

The fastest morning train from New Delhi to Agra Cantt is the Shatabdi 12002, leaving 6:00 AM and arriving 7:50 AM (1 hr 50 min, CC and EC seats).

Other morning trains from New Delhi:

Punjab Mail 12138: 5:10 AM → 8:10 AM (3 hr)
Taj Express 12280: 6:55 AM → 9:25 AM (2 hr 30 min)
Hirakund Express 20808: 8:15 AM → 10:35 AM (2 hr 20 min)
HSX AGC Express 11906: 7:20 AM → 11:00 AM (3 hr 40 min)
NDLS-DHO local train 64074: 4:15 AM → 9:05 AM (4 hr 50 min)

From nearby Hazrat Nizamuddin station, the Vande Bharat 22470 leaves 6:00 AM and arrives 7:40 AM, and the Gatimaan Express 12050 leaves 8:10 AM and arrives 9:50 AM.

IRCTC blocked me, so these times come from another site and the page was cut off after 11:15 AM. Seats and fares aren't checked, so confirm them on IRCTC before you plan around them.
